claims.text: GGUF availability confirmed: UD-IQ1_S 1-bit 93.09GB through BF16 ~642GB with per-quant top-1/KLD table (1-bit 70.89% top-1, 85% smaller; 3-bit 120GB/81.6%, 4-bit 200GB/92.2%); memory-fit guidance 1-bit ~100GB RAM, 3-bit 128-150GB; llama.cpp + Unsloth Desktop paths with UD-IQ3_XXS demo default.
claims.context: Docs page fully consumed this pass (unsloth.ai/docs/models/glm-5.3-flash); 320B/18B ox-alpha identity, 30T tokens, 1M context, Low/High/Max thinking, temp 1.0/top-p 0.95.

claims.text: MTP support implemented in the Unsloth llama.cpp fork (PR unslothai/llama.cpp#61 branch glm5next/upstream; distinct from ggml-org PR 27742 for Qwen); 3.3x-faster-inference claim is vendor-measured (B200 UD-IQ1_S tok/s table, n=2 MTP best) and requires independent confirmation.
claims.context: Implementation existence confirmed; speedup figures quarantined.

claims.text: Vendor benchmark table (Terminal-Bench 2.1 84.3, DeepSWE v1.1 63.4, Toolathlon 78.4 vs Opus 4.8/GPT-5.6 Terra/Gemini 3.7 Flash) is harness-bound vendor reporting, cited for no fact.
